notes.title: More small demo changes
notes.notes:
I made some small changes to smooth out the demo experience while also doing background stuff. The demo includes a new playable level, the Foam cave!

-tweaked the smooth camera to move differently when the character jumps
-adjustments to cosy courier level to make it teach better, and to several levels to tweak annoying hitboxes
 -fixed some bugs in djinn's cave

I took some time making some trailers for events and recording/editing a gameplay video. 
I am currently working on some shroud for the worldmap, but it isn't implemented yet.

The game will be up in Steam Next Fest next week, I hope you'll give it a try.
You can also do so right now, don't hesitate to wishlist if you like it! I'm always happy to get feedback. 

https://i.imgur.com/u4g5Rku.png

notes.title: Menu and UI update part 2
notes.notes:
I kept working on the menus this month. I added a "settings" part in the pause menu with new options. 

Added settings for music volume and sound volume in there
Added settings for fullscreen and windowed in there

Other options in that settings screen (control mapping & language) aren't implemented yet, although you can still configure your controls from the main menu.

https://i.imgur.com/9Fo2iKB.png

Control mapping menu can now be navigated with keyboard
Added a "reset controls to default" button in there, as well as a "confirm controls" button which prevents errors
Implemented menu icons lighting up properly and added some help text to navigate menus (there's still a few errors lurking that I must fix)
The new settings are saved when you update them

And that's it for this update. There's still menu stuff to do but my priorities lie elsewhere right now, I will be focusing on making the demo feel polished for the steam next fest to come.

notes.title: Menu and UI update (part 1)
notes.notes:
I finally started working on the last big visual thing I'd postponed for so long : making the menus a bit handier and prettier. 

-Changed the text font
-New menu UI design, including new button and icon designs
-You can now navigate menus with arrow keys and confirm with pickup key (space by default). This isn't implemented on all menus yet
-When completing a level, you now go back to the worldmap and an unlock level animation is played, if relevant
-Fixed timed ticking while the level is paused
-Level design tweaks

I still have some work ahead of me for the menus I want to have, so I'll keep working on these aspects of the project.
